newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Senior management changes at Natwest Markets Asia.
newsitem.headline: Senior management changes at Natwest Markets Asia.

text.p: Natwest Markets on Wednesday announced changes in the senior management of its Asia Pacific business.

Frank Wong has been appointed regional head of Greater China in addition to his existing responsibilities as head of the Global Financial Markets division throughout Asia Pacific, the company said in a statement.
Wong is also chairman of the Hong Kong Futures Exchange.
He replaces Trevor Bush who will be returning to a senior position in the Global Debt Markets division of NatWest Markets in London in the second quarter of 1997, it said.
An Asia Pacific Debt Markets division is being established under the leadership of Bruce Chapman, currently a managing director within the NatWest Markets Asia Pacific Regional Office.
The Wheelock Natwest business acquried by Natwest Markets in November will now operate as part of the Global Equities Division under the name of Natwest Securities Asia, the statement said.
